ExactCurrentEN: The RMMMG is €2,189.81 gross per month from 1 April 2026 for covered workers aged 18 and over under CCT 43. It is an average monthly minimum-income guarantee, not a universal hourly Belgian minimum and not necessarily the simple base wage paid each month. CCT 43 does not apply to student workers aged 18–20; they are covered by a separate reduced guarantee under CCT 50. A sectoral collective agreement (CCT) may set a higher minimum. Check the applicable joint committee and job classification on your payslip or with the employer.
